name: Zorita de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and blue, the white charged with a red lion rampant crowned yellow and the blue with a yellow eradicated pine.
history: The flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, white with a red lion rampant armed and crowned yellow at the hoist and blue with a yellow eradicated pine at the fly.

features.role: lion rampant armed and crowned yellow
